posts.text: Do the documents that President Donald Trump published on the White House website prove anything? During his July 16 primetime address, Trump told America that he had proof of unlawful things that happened in 2020 and that he would publish those documents. However, the documents he has published so far do not prove anything other than theories and conjectures. The only documented facts he has published have been known for many years.
posts.summary: Questions whether Trump's published documents substantiate 2020 claims
